# Shuffle Timeline

Official page: https://jumpstyle.com.br/STL/
Instagram: https://instagram.com/shuffletimeline
Repository: https://github.com/Mreaggle/shuffle-timeline

This is a static investigative extraction of the Shuffle Timeline artwork. The first editorial block is not treated as a historical timeline event.

Timeline blocks: 14
Eras: Underground Era (1985–1997); Transition Era (1998–2005); YouTube & Facebook Era (2006–2014); Instagram & TikTok Era (2015–2024)
